title: Design strategies for tetrazine fluorogenic probes for bioorthogonal imaging
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D3CS00520H, Review Article
Aiwen Yu, Xinyu He, Tianruo Shen, Xinyu Yu, Wuyu Mao, Weijie Chi, Xiaogang Liu, Haoxing Wu
In this review, recent progress in tetrazine-based fluorogenic probes for bioorthogonal chemistry is comprehensively analyzed, with a focus on advancements in probe design and their imaging applications for molecular processes in live cells.
